pages.text: A $(l)Resin$() is a one-shot additive that makes a blueprint print come out $(l)finer$() — better, not just bigger. Drop one into the $(l)Resin slot$() (between the upgrade and spool columns) before you print.$(br2)A resin only works on $(l)found blueprints$() (looted or creative discs, never your own scans), and it's $(l)consumed$() per print — but only when it has something to do. Slot one with nothing to act on (Treasure with no chests, say) and the printer leaves it untouched.

pages.title: Rarity
pages.text: Resins come in three rarities. $(l)Common$() and $(l)Uncommon$() are craftable; $(l)Rare$() is found only, in end-game loot. Rarer resins are stronger — and a few effects exist only at the top.
Everything starts with $(item)Resin Base$() — $(item)Extrudium Crystal$() plus any slimeball. Add a rarity ingredient (a gem makes it $(l)Uncommon$()) and an effect ingredient to finish a resin.
